name: GoldArc Resources Limited
summary: GoldArc Resources Limited, operating with its subsidiaries, is dedicated to exploring gold and rare earth mineral properties throughout Australia. Its principal asset is the Mt Stirling project, an exploration area spanning 222 square kilometers, located in Leonora, Western Australia. The company, which was previously known as Asra Minerals Limited, officially changed its name to GoldArc Resources Limited in September 2025. Founded in 1981, the firm's headquarters are situated in West Perth, Australia.
